map.以「冷启动正常、怠速轻微抖动、无渗漏、加速响应良好」为例: Take "normal cold start, slight idle vibration, no leaks, good acceleration response" as an example
map.：10 项各按权重计分（正常=满分、轻微=部分、异常=0 并记入问题）。怠速轻微: The 10 items are scored by weight (normal = full marks, mild = partial, abnormal = 0 and recorded as an issue). Slight idle vibration loses some points while everything else is normal, so the engine score sits in the upper-middle range and flags "slight idle vibration" as a risk point; if oil leakage and metallic noise also appear, several items score 0, the total drops sharply and it is judged high risk, so consider abandoning the vehicle or budgeting an overhaul.
map.发动机评分的权重怎么分布？: How Should the Engine Score Weights Be Distributed?
map.启动、怠速、加速等核心工况权重较高，异响/渗漏等故障指征按严重程度计 0 并单列: Core conditions such as starting, idle and acceleration carry higher weight, while fault indicators such as abnormal noise and leaks score 0 by severity and are listed separately as issues. The total is aggregated by weight and mapped to excellent / good / fair / poor. The specific weights are built into each item's configuration.
